compat_note: TS composes one dotted wire key '<guildId>.<PATH>' (client.db.get/set over table 'json'; server resolves dot-nesting). Rust splits the same logical key into scope+key: tbl_get/set(pool, gid='<guildId>', key='<PATH>'), recomposed on the wire as horizon_key '{scope}.{key}'. kv_* uses the same (guild_id, key) split with legacy flat rows. So logical equality holds iff TS '<gid>.<PATH>' == Rust (gid='<gid>', key='<PATH>').
